title: The value function of a bounded purchase
heading: A Price Is a Line That Touches the Value Function From Above, and a Step Function Has Almost None
cases: z(d) is the best value of any purchase that fits in d, for every d from 0 to the capacity
a type may be bought up to its limit, not just once
a type is never bought more times than its limit allows
a plan need not use the whole capacity, so z never falls as d grows
